title: Robbery of Banco Totta and Azores, in Mira de Aire, on October 15, 1975
summary: Wikidata item Q116465304, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Assault carried out by elements of the PRP-BR, with 1300 contos stolen". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
